headline: Ravindra Energy JV opens EV truck complex in Pune
summary: Ravindra Energy's jointly controlled entity, Energy in Motion Ltd, inaugurated an electric heavy-duty commercial vehicle complex in Talegaon, Pune. The facility features a 5,000 vehicles/shift/year capacity and integrates battery assembly with testing labs.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: TechM, IIFL, Angel One in focus
summary: Tech Mahindra rallies 4.75% on strong Q2 earnings and bonus issue, while IIFL Finance jumps 93% YoY profit beat. Check other key movers here.

headline: Wipro acquires 20% stake in FLARRE.AI for $2,000
summary: Wipro Limited, through its subsidiary Wipro IT Services LLC, signed a definitive agreement to acquire a 20% stake in FLARRE.AI, Inc. The deal aims to enhance AI capabilities for the global insurance sector.

headline: Supreme Court upholds Yes Bank AT1 bond write-down
summary: The Supreme Court dismissed appeals against the Bombay High Court's order, upholding the write-down of ₹8,415 crore in AT1 bonds. The bank is evaluating legal options and capital actions.

headline: Vascon Engineers wins ₹198 crore SBI contract in Pune
summary: Vascon Engineers has secured a ₹198 crore construction contract from State Bank of India for a project in Pune, marking a significant order win for the company.

headline: Bombay Burmah shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 22,42,787 shares of Bombay Burmah Trading at ₹1,232.25 per share on BSE, with a combined value of ₹276.37 crore.

headline: Organic Recycling Systems wins fifth BPCL CBG order
summary: Organic Recycling Systems secured its fifth contract from BPCL for a CBG plant in Chhattisgarh, valued between ₹50-100 crore, taking total BPCL orders to ₹350-500 crore.

headline: ArmEE Infotech cancels ₹740.97 crore solar EPC orders
summary: ArmEE Infotech has cancelled solar EPC orders worth ₹740.97 crore placed with Bondada Engineering, citing rising raw material costs as the reason for the termination.

headline: Tata Comms targets EBITDA positivity
summary: Tata Communications aims for profitable growth and EBITDA expansion in the current year. Core connectivity margins are estimated at 44.8% for the quarter, expected to remain stable.

headline: Rupee opens stronger at 84.71 vs dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 84.71 against the US dollar, stronger than the previous close of 85.0550, reflecting an appreciation in the domestic currency.

headline: Axis Bank appoints ex-SEBI member as director
summary: Axis Bank appoints Ananth Narayan G., former SEBI whole-time member, as additional independent director for four years, effective October 19, 2026.

headline: STL Networks appoints two senior leaders
summary: STL Networks Ltd appointed Kiran Patel as Design & Operations Head-DC and Gaurav Barjatiya as Chief Sales & Marketing Officer. Both roles are designated as Senior Management Personnel.

headline: Karur Vysya Bank COO Chandrasekaran M S demits office
summary: Chandrasekaran M S, Chief Operating Officer of Karur Vysya Bank, demitted office on October 15, 2026, following tenure completion. Ramshankar R assumes the role from October 16.

headline: DCW Ltd promoter group shifts 3.71% stake
summary: DCW Ltd discloses inter-se transfer of 3.71% equity shares among promoter group members. Aggregate holding remains unchanged at 45.59%.

headline: Bhavna Jhunjhunwala cuts Vibrant Global stake to 3.67%
summary: Bhavna Jhunjhunwala sold 17,39,052 shares of Vibrant Global Capital Ltd via open market sale on October 14, 2026. Her holding dropped from 11.26% to 3.67%.

headline: Nirlon shares shift between InRe entities
summary: BSREP IV FPI Two Holdings acquired 23.25 lakh Nirlon shares from InRe Fund II via inter-se transfer, consolidating a 15.06% stake without changing aggregate holding.

headline: Swan Corp promoter pledges 15 lakh shares
summary: Swan Engitech Works pledged 15,00,000 equity shares of Swan Corp Ltd to IDBI Trusteeship for a ₹1,150 crore facility from NaBFID.

headline: Leap India promoter revises pledge disclosure
summary: Sunu Mathew revised disclosure to include debenture holders in pledge details. 2.25 crore shares encumbered as security for Matyas Possessions debentures.

headline: Standard Engineering allots shares to AGI Group
summary: Standard Engineering Technology Ltd allotted 24.4 lakh equity shares at ₹293 each, raising ₹71.5 crore from AGI Group and Monoflus Pte Ltd on a preferential basis.

headline: Valor Estate promoter pledges 1.66 crore shares
summary: Goenka Family Trust pledged 1.66 crore Valor Estate shares to Authum Investment to secure a financial facility for the company.

headline: Anand Rathi Wealth promoter shifts pledge to Yes Bank
summary: Anand Rathi Financial Services Limited released and re-pledged 88.46 lakh shares of Anand Rathi Wealth, moving collateral from Suresh Rathi Securities to Yes Bank.

headline: Tuni Textile Q2FY27: Net profit jumps 114% YoY
summary: Tuni Textile Mills reported a 113.6% YoY rise in net profit to ₹1.66 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by a 17.4% increase in net revenue from operations.

headline: SMT IPO Day 2: Subscribed 0.43x
summary: Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO saw overall subscription at 0.43x on Day 2. Retail led with 0.54x, while QIB interest remained low at 0.37x.

headline: Shivchem Agro cites SME exemption for RPT rules
summary: Shivchem Agro Limited declared non-applicability of SEBI Regulation 23(9) due to SME listing exemption. The company is exempt from related party disclosures under specific capital and net worth thresholds.

headline: Indus Finance proposes 5:9 bonus issue
summary: Indus Finance Ltd seeks shareholder approval to issue five bonus shares for every nine held, capitalising ₹5.14 crore from reserves. Voting runs Oct 22 to Nov 20, 2026.

headline: SPR Auto Technologies Q2FY27 earnings call scheduled
summary: SPR Auto Technologies Limited will host its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call on November 2, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST. The virtual event is open to analysts and investors.

headline: Aban Offshore discloses ₹281 crore suspended preference shares
summary: Aban Offshore disclosed ₹281 crore in outstanding Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference shares under suspension since 2014. The company set off ₹18 crore against Axis Bank dues.

headline: Dee Development Engineers signs nuclear power EPC pact
summary: Dee Development Engineers has signed an agreement with a local EPC firm to support the nuclear power sector, marking a strategic move into nuclear energy services.
